name: Expressions of Pink Large by 1-800 Flowers
description: When words arent enough, let our thoughtful and timeless arrangement reveal the depths of your feelings. Filled with a delicate mix of roses, lilies and carnations in various shades of pink, this lovely surprise is hand-designed by our skilled florists inside a clear glass gathering vase tied with ribbon to let the beauty of each bloom shine through…and to let your most heartfelt sentiments be known.
